points.description: One row per level: what the stat is worth there, and what the point that reached it bought.

gain.description: What this point bought over the last. Null on the first row.

requirements_unmet.description: Stats short of the weapon's requirement here. While any is, the curve is flat for a reason that has nothing to do with the stat being walked.

bends.description: Where the curve turns: the level after which each point buys materially less. This is a soft cap measured rather than recited.

level.description: The last level before the drop.

kept.description: The fraction of the gain that survives the bend. 0.5 means each point after is worth half.

soft_caps.description: Just the bend levels. Vigor comes back [40, 60] — the two everybody names, arrived at rather than repeated.

total_gain.description: What the whole range is worth.

best_point.description: The single most valuable level in the range.

requirements_unmet.description: Stats whose requirement is unmet somewhere in the range. Non-empty is the explanation for a flat curve.
